name: xros
description: Executable research operating system. Four skills: compile a long-horizon investigation into a verifiable methodology spec, sharpen an un-checkable question into a falsifiable claim with its best-available check, run the Tier-A/B search engine gated on a real oracle, or reason through a no-oracle (Tier-C) claim with premises, pre-mortem, and dated tripwires. Refuses to claim a verified result without a mechanical check.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a question into a verifiable spec, then gate the verdict on a real check
interface.longDescription: XROS is an eXecutable Research Operating System. It turns an investigation into a verifiable methodology spec, runs it against a real check, and gates the verdict on that check's exit code. Its one rule is 'no verification, no claim': a result is reported as verified only when a mechanical check actually passed. Where no such check exists, XROS says so and refuses the strong mode instead of producing confident text with nothing anchoring it. A three-tier model is enforced by the bundled schema and validator — a sound oracle (Tier A) may return a verified complete result, a statistical check (Tier B) yields evidence only, and no check (Tier C) is routed to structured reasoning labeled UNVERIFIED. Newcomers can start from a bare domain: the sharpen skill maps a field's minimal vocabulary before framing anything.
defaultPrompt: Compile my research question into an XROS spec with $xros-compile.
I don't know this field yet — orient me and find a real check with $xros-sharpen.
Run this XROS spec and gate the verdict on its oracle with $xros-run.
